title: Exact passive observation-law overlap inside a narrow uncertain physical-decay envelope

provenance.model_family: stationary scalar OU process followed by first-order low-pass sensor

model.covariance_kernel: C(h)=q*exp(-r*h)*(1+r*h*psi(g*h)); r=min(lambda,mu); g=abs(lambda-mu); psi(x)=(1-exp(-x))/x and psi(0)=1
model.observed_finite_design_law: Y_D ~ N(0,K_D+R_D), with complete pairwise covariance retained
model.equality_claim: If lambda_B=mu_A, mu_B=lambda_A and q_B=q_A, then the complete stationary covariance kernels are identical for every h>=0. Adding the same declared readout covariance R_D preserves equality of every finite-dimensional observation law.

uncertain_world_b_family.interpretation: synthetic +/-1% interval around nominal 4.04; not a physical measurement uncertainty claim

exact_overlap_witness.proof_method: exact rational pole-swap identity; rates and q compared using normalized rational arithmetic
exact_overlap_witness.finite_design_kl: 0 for every common finite sampling design with identical readout covariance, in exact arithmetic

plus_minus_half_percent.limitation: Excluding this pole-swap witness is not a general proof that all possible observation-law intersections are absent.

composite_test_consequence.families: P_A={P_A,eta:eta in Theta_A}; P_B={P_B,xi:xi in Theta_B}
composite_test_consequence.worst_case_power: inf_{P in P_A} E_P[phi(Y)] <= alpha when P_A and P_B overlap
composite_test_consequence.interpretation: Any uniformly size-controlled possibly randomized passive test has worst-case power no larger than alpha over the full composite alternative family.
composite_test_consequence.additional_samples: Cannot break the exact family-level overlap; only changing the observation protocol can remove the shared distribution.

passive_protocol.note: Reuses the #14065 design as finite-design diagnostics; equality is established from the full analytic kernel, not from the finite grid.

intervention_positive_control.claim_boundary: synthetic noiseless step response; physical stimulus uncertainty, calibration and readout noise must be separately declared

negative_controls.expected: Do not call the lambda_B=4.04 fixed pair an exact alias.
Detect the lambda_B=4 exact witness inside the declared interval.
Do not claim the specific lambda_B=4 witness is inside this narrower interval.
Adding the same measurement-noise covariance to both equal latent laws preserves equality.
Increasing n does not resolve an exact family intersection.
A changed, calibrated observation protocol can distinguish sensor rates in this synthetic challenge.
Do not replace the declared nuisance interval with its nominal point estimate.

independent_replay.method: independent SciPy/NumPy construction of the same OU covariance law and exact rational arithmetic check

claim_boundary: Synthetic analytical proof that the declared composite World B family contains an exact passive observation-law alias. The +/-1% interval is illustrative only and is not a claim about real sensor uncertainty.
